prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 4 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 10 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a colouring-book drawing: contours only, in one thin uniform black line on white, most of the panel left white. Draw only the people and the few large shapes of the place (walls, doors, windows, a bed, a car). People are simple storyboard figures: hair is one smooth outline of its shape, like a cap, empty inside, with no strands, curls or waves; a face has one short line each for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and no stubble, wrinkles or jaw lines; a fence is its posts and top rail, a tree its outline. No texture, mesh, bricks, leaves or fabric folds; no shading, grey or solid black: dark hair, clothes and cars are outlines left white inside. Thin black panel borders, plain white gutters. Location: Garden of the wedding venue, Day, bright sunny garden light.
Image 1: the character sheet of Guest 1 (25)
Image 2: the character sheet of Guest 2 (25)
Image 3: the character sheet of Lauren (50), look S1
Image 4: the character sheet of Cassie (23), look S1
Image 5: the character sheet of Sebastian (30), look S2
Image 6: the character sheet of Natalie (25), look S1
Image 7: the character sheet of George (55), look S1
Image 8: the character sheet of Officiant (58)
Image 9: the location Garden of the wedding venue, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 10: the location Garden of the wedding venue, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 11: the location Garden of the wedding venue, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 12: the location Garden of the wedding venue, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 13: the location Garden of the wedding venue, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 14: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 15: the prop Lauren's phone; use only structure, material, and color
Image 16: the prop Natalie's phone; use only structure, material, and color
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image, by the shape of the hairstyle, the build and the outfit in outline only; never copy the photograph's detail. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Natalie and Sebastian stand side by side under the centre of the wedding arch, facing down the aisle, Sebastian on the boxwood-hedge side of Natalie. George stands beside Natalie under the arch on the rose-bush side, holding the bouquet. The Officiant stands just behind the couple at the centre of the arch. Lauren stands at the head of the aisle against the front-row chair on the boxwood-hedge side, gripping her handbag, and Cassie stands beside her on her arch side, arms folded over the empty gift box. Natalie's phone lies face up on the seat of the front-row chair on the rose-bush side. Guest 1 (arch side) and Guest 2 (aisle side) stand at the one small round white high cocktail table on the boxwood-hedge side, each holding a champagne flute, Guest 1's phone in the clutch under her arm.
Panel 1: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level. At the cocktail table by the hedge, Guest 1 sets her flute on the silver tray, pulls her pink phone from her clutch and raises it vertically toward the family to record, and Guest 2 leans in beside her with her champagne glass.
Panel 2: Medium shot, quick whip pan following Lauren's turn, eye-level, Cassie's shoulder at the frame edge. Lauren, at the front-row chair on the hedge side, spins toward the cocktail table and jabs a finger at Guest 1, Cassie beside her.
Panel 3: Medium shot, slight low angle, slow push in on Sebastian. Sebastian, beside Natalie under the arch, spreads one hand toward the raised phone with a cool smile, his eyes on Lauren.
Panel 4: Medium close-up, clean single framed tight on face and shoulders, locked-off camera, eye-level. Natalie's eyes glisten and her jaw sets as she looks at Lauren.
Panel 5: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the rose-bush side of the aisle. George crosses from beside Natalie under the arch to Lauren's aisle side at the front-row chair, the bouquet in one hand, and grips her arm with the other, his face set.
Panel 6: Close-up, high angle over her hands, locked-off camera. Lauren pulls her phone in its lilac case from her handbag and stabs furiously at the banking transfer page with her thumb.
Panel 7: Close-up insert, high angle, locked-off camera. Natalie's phone lights up on the seat of the front-row chair on the rose-bush side, and Natalie's hand lifts it, the bank notification banner on the lock screen.
Panel 8: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the rose-bush side of the aisle. Natalie, now standing at the rose-bush end of the arch beside the front-row chair, looks up from her phone at Lauren; the Officiant stands behind her under the arch.
Panel 9: Medium close-up, clean single, locked-off camera, eye-level. Sebastian, under the arch, slips his hands into his pockets and gives Lauren a lazy smile.
Panel 10: Close-up, clean single on her face, locked-off camera, eye-level. Lauren lowers her phone, her lips pressed into a thin line and her nostrils flaring.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering.
